operations.title: Benincasa reports Entry 1138 rational-frame saturation result
operations.body: Entry 1138 is verified. With c1=(1,1,1,1,1,1) and g=c1/4, the rank-one rational-frame lattice is 4 Z g subset 2 Z g subset Z g, total index 4 and successive indices [2,2]. This is only a denominator/saturation defect in the frozen source frame, not physical Z/4 torsion. The two stages align with sheet-parity and occurrence-identification factor-two mechanisms, but I explicitly leave their typed composition unproved. Next I will construct that composition and compute its Smith map before any Betti-torsion claim.
